label: APC Rack PDU 2G Switched 20A/208V (21xC13 3xC19)
description: Zero-U switched rack PDU with 21x C13 and 3x C19 outlets on a 20A/208V (16A/230V) C20 input, giving per-outlet power switching plus branch and total current metering for a rack. One 10/100BASE-T RJ45 network port provides Web, SNMP and Telnet management, and network port sharing lets up to four 8000-series PDUs be managed behind one IP address; the DB9/RJ12 serial port is configuration only.
notes: APC rack PDU family spec: '9000 series PDUs provide Gigabit Ethernet... All other models provide 10/100 ethernet connectivity' - the AP8959 is an 8000-series unit, hence Fast Ethernet. Network port sharing chains up to 4 PDUs on 8000 series (32 on 9000 series) over the RJ45 link port, which is a PDU-to-PDU bus and not an Ethernet segment. Discontinued Nov 2024.
